applicablePathways.notes: The 30-minute walking declaration is an entry scope condition drawn from the existing pack and NHS-aligned return-to-running guidance. It is not medical clearance, a prediction of injury risk, or a proof that the authored run/walk table suits an individual.

20/50/20 are original candidate comparators matching the continuous draft's Week 1 Session C main work (20 minutes) and Week 1 main-work total (50 minutes). They are not independently validated safety thresholds and require qualified coach approval.

rules.condition: When a dated running-history observation is supplied, its age must be no more than 28 days.
Continuous pathway requires reported continuous running of at least 20 minutes.
Continuous pathway requires at least 50 recent weekly running minutes.
Continuous pathway requires a recent longest running session of at least 20 minutes.
Run/walk pathway requires an adult declaration, comfortable 30-minute walking, no reported health concern, and an accepted three-day schedule.
Any reported interruption other than none requires review; there is no automatic re-entry rule.
Each selected weekday limit must meet the exact scheduled full-session duration, including the 10-minute walk warm-up/cooldown.

evidence.title: NHS Better Health: Couch to 5K running plan
evidence.supports: Three weekly beginner sessions, rest days, 5-minute walk warm-up/cooldown, and an initial timed run/walk pattern. NHS uses a separate 9-week programme and does not validate our 12-week tables or individual compatibility thresholds.

evidence.title: Berkshire Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust: Return to running programme
evidence.supports: A general guide says people should be able to walk for 30 minutes and uses two to three sessions weekly with 24 hours between. It is return-to-running guidance and says individual physiotherapy advice may differ.

evidence.title: The Association Between Running Injuries and Training Parameters: A Systematic Review
evidence.supports: Specific training-parameter and injury relationships were inconsistent. It supports caution and review, not a universal safe progression threshold.

evidence.title: RunSensei Continuous-Running Beginner 5K Pack, Week 1
evidence.supports: The proposed continuous pack has 15/15/20 minutes of Week 1 main work, 50 minutes total. This is the source of candidate comparator values, not external validation.

fallbacks.missingEvidence: Return insufficient_information; do not infer capacity from missing answers.
fallbacks.contradictoryEvidence: Return conflicting_evidence; do not average or select a pathway.
fallbacks.outdatedEvidence: Return insufficient_information and request a current observation.
fallbacks.healthConcern: Return health_hold; this is not a diagnosis or medical clearance.
fallbacks.interruption: Return requires_review; do not automatically re-enter or regress a programme.
fallbacks.productionActivation: Blocked. Candidate compatibility does not authorize plan creation or activation.

notes: Draft research policy. Numeric values are either existing programme values or original candidate comparators. It cannot be used as medical advice or production coaching until qualified running-coach review and release approval occur.
